change_log.author: Design team (draft)
change_log.summary: First provisional rule set. Points are ordinal evidence tiers converted to points by expert judgement; they are NOT fitted coefficients. Requires calibration on DRC line-list data and approval by the DRC Ministry of Health (INSP / PNLFHV), INRB and clinical/IPC experts.

change_log.author: Design team (draft)
change_log.summary: Symptom list replaced by the 23 supplied symptoms (labels as supplied). Nausea and jaundice removed; anorexia, joint pain, cough, other signs, DT, respiratory breathing, coma, hiccups, DRO, ICT added. DT/DRO/ICT unexpanded and unscored pending definitions. Correlation groups (gi, pain, neuro) with group caps so that correlated symptoms do not add up freely. Coma flags urgent clinical review without scoring.

output_label: Score de suspicion BDBV (0-100) - indice ordinal, PAS une probabilite d'infection
output_label_en: BDBV suspicion score (0-100) - ordinal index, NOT a probability of infection

evidence_tiers.A: Element of WHO/ECDC Ebola disease case or contact definition (structure to be confirmed against the current DRC national definition).
evidence_tiers.B: Independent predictor of laboratory-confirmed Ebola disease in two or more triage derivation studies, including at least one from DRC.
evidence_tiers.C: Predictor in a single study, or conflicting findings across studies.
evidence_tiers.D: Biological plausibility or expert judgement only; no derivation-study support found. Low or zero weight.

items.rationale: Entry criterion of the WHO suspected-case definition; temperature > 38.5 C strongest predictor in Guinea (OR 18.1); pyrexia among the highest-odds characteristics in Sierra Leone. Low specificity where malaria is common.
Asthenia/fatigue independent predictor in both DRC derivation studies.
Independently associated with confirmed EVD in DRC 10th-outbreak validation; listed WHO symptom.
Independent predictor in Liberia and Sierra Leone; listed WHO symptom.
Listed WHO symptom; not an independent predictor in the derivation studies reviewed.
Anorexia/loss of appetite independently associated with EVD in Guinea (OR 2.5), Liberia and DRC (Kebela).
Conflicting: associated with EVD in DRC (Kebela) but its absence was predictive in Liberia (Levine).
Part of "muscle/joint pain" in earlier studies; conflicting evidence (favours malaria in Sierra Leone).
Positive predictor in Liberia and DRC (Kebela); more predictive of EVD-negative/malaria in Sierra Leone (Hartley).
Not a predictor in the studies reviewed; collected for differential diagnosis. Zero weight.

items.label_sw: Dalili nyingine zisizo za kutokwa damu
items.rationale: Free-text clinical detail; not scored.
Abbreviation retained as supplied; definition to be confirmed by the clinical and surveillance teams. Not scored until defined.
Label kept as supplied; exact definition (e.g. difficulty breathing) to confirm. Dyspnoea is a prognostic (severity) sign in Hartley 2017, not a diagnostic predictor. Not scored.
Unexplained bleeding is part of the WHO suspected-case definition; gingival bleeding and haematemesis predictive in both DRC studies. Often late: absence does not reassure.
Predictor in DRC (Tshomba), Liberia (Levine) and Sierra Leone (Hartley).
Predictor in one DRC derivation study (Yango).
Severity sign; no diagnostic-predictor evidence found. Not scored, but flags urgent clinical review.
Described in EVD and prognostic in Hartley 2017 (severity), not shown as a diagnostic predictor. Minimal weight.
Collected for description and differential diagnosis (e.g. mpox, measles). Zero weight.
Predictor in both DRC studies (conjunctivitis; red eyes) and in Sierra Leone.
Predictor in one DRC study (Tshomba).

items.label_fr: Contact avec un cas suspect, probable ou confirme d'Ebola
items.label_en: Contact with a suspected, probable or confirmed Ebola case
items.rationale: Core of WHO suspected-case and contact definitions; contact with an EVD case/sick person was an independent predictor in every derivation study reviewed (DRC x2, Liberia, Sierra Leone).
items.label_sw: Kugusana na mgonjwa anayeshukiwa, anayewezekana au aliyethibitishwa kuwa na Ebola

items.label_fr: Participation a la preparation funeraire ou a l'inhumation d'un cas suspect/confirme
items.label_en: Funeral preparation or burial of a suspected/confirmed case
items.rationale: Direct contact with the body of a deceased case is a recognised high-risk exposure in WHO contact definitions.
items.label_sw: Kushiriki katika kuandaa maiti au mazishi ya mtu anayeshukiwa/aliyethibitishwa kuwa na Ebola

items.label_fr: Exposition en laboratoire a des echantillons potentiellement infectieux
items.label_en: Laboratory exposure to potentially infectious specimens
items.rationale: Exposure to laboratory biological material is treated as a contact exposure in WHO definitions.
items.label_sw: Kugusana na sampuli zinazoweza kuambukiza katika maabara

items.label_fr: Contact sexuel avec un cas suspect/confirme (ou survivant)
items.label_en: Sexual contact with a suspected/confirmed case (or survivor)
items.rationale: Recognised transmission route including from survivors; treated as a contact exposure. Weight slightly below direct-care contact pending BDBV-specific data.
items.label_sw: Kufanya ngono na mgonjwa anayeshukiwa/aliyethibitishwa (au aliyepona)

items.label_fr: Contact avec un environnement ou du materiel contamine (linge, literie, liquides)
items.label_en: Contact with contaminated environment or materials
items.rationale: Contact with soiled clothing/linen/body fluids is part of WHO contact definition; lower than direct contact as exposure is less certain.
items.label_sw: Kugusa mazingira au vitu vilivyochafuliwa (nguo, matandiko, majimaji ya mwili)

items.label_fr: Contact avec une personne malade ou decedee d'une maladie inexpliquee compatible
items.label_en: Contact with a person with unexplained compatible illness or death
items.rationale: 'Contact with a sick person' was an independent predictor in DRC (Yango), Liberia and Sierra Leone. Lower than known-case contact because the source case is unclassified.
items.label_sw: Kugusana na mtu mgonjwa au aliyefariki kwa ugonjwa usioelezeka unaofanana

items.label_fr: Chasse, manipulation, abattage ou consommation de chauves-souris / viande de brousse
items.label_en: Handling, hunting, slaughtering or eating bats / bushmeat
items.rationale: Plausible zoonotic spill-over route listed in WHO guidance; during established human-to-human transmission its discriminative value is likely low. Moderate weight; recalibrate.
items.label_sw: Kuwinda, kushika, kuchinja au kula popo / nyama ya porini

items.label_fr: Visite chez un tradipraticien / lieu de priere de guerison (ajout propose)
items.label_en: Visit to a traditional healer / healing prayer site (proposed addition)
items.rationale: Independent predictor in DRC (Yango); proxy for contact with sick people. Proposed addition.
items.label_sw: Kumtembelea mganga wa kienyeji / mahali pa maombi ya uponyaji (nyongeza inayopendekezwa)

items.label_fr: Visite ou soins dans une structure ayant recu des cas d'Ebola, injection (ajout propose)
items.label_en: Attended a facility treating Ebola cases or received injections (proposed addition)
items.rationale: WHO toolbox lists contact with a hospital treating Ebola cases and injections in the preceding 21 days as risk factors (nosocomial transmission).
items.label_sw: Kutembelea au kutibiwa katika kituo kilichopokea wagonjwa wa Ebola, au kupewa sindano (nyongeza inayopendekezwa)

items.label_fr: Residence ou sejour dans une zone de sante avec transmission active (21 jours)
items.label_en: Lived in / travelled to a health zone with active transmission (21 days)
items.rationale: Being in an affected area within 21 days is the epidemiological criterion of the ECDC 2026 interim BDBV definition. The list of affected zones must be maintained by national surveillance.
items.label_sw: Kuishi au kusafiri katika eneo la afya lenye maambukizi (siku 21)

floors.label_fr: Compatible avec la structure de la definition OMS de cas suspect : signes compatibles + exposition a haut risque dans les 21 jours
floors.label_en: Consistent with the structure of the WHO suspected-case definition: compatible illness + high-risk exposure within 21 days
floors.requires_confirmation: Must be replaced by the exact current DRC national (PNLFHV/INSP) suspected-case definition for BDBV.
floors.label_sw: Inalingana na muundo wa ufafanuzi wa WHO wa mgonjwa anayeshukiwa: dalili zinazofanana + kugusana kwa hatari kubwa ndani ya siku 21

floors.label_fr: Fievre avec saignement inexplique (syndrome hemorragique) - meme sans exposition connue
floors.label_en: Fever with unexplained bleeding (haemorrhagic syndrome) - even without known exposure
floors.requires_confirmation: Confirm whether national guidance classifies this as suspected case (RED) in affected provinces.
floors.label_sw: Homa pamoja na kutokwa damu bila sababu (dalili za kutokwa damu) - hata bila kugusana kunakojulikana

floors.label_fr: Deces brutal inexplique d'une personne venant d'une zone affectee (evaluation post-mortem)
floors.label_en: Sudden unexplained death of a person from an affected area (post-mortem assessment)
floors.requires_confirmation: Aligns with WHO/ECDC probable-case logic for deceased persons; confirm national procedure (safe burial, post-mortem swab).
floors.label_sw: Kifo cha ghafla kisichoelezeka cha mtu kutoka eneo lenye maambukizi (tathmini baada ya kifo)

community.note: Community signals produce an AREA concern level shown alongside - never added to - the individual score.

levels.label_sw: Wasiwasi mkubwa sana - uchunguzi wa kipaumbele

community.advisory_fr: Des signaux communautaires recents existent dans la zone du patient. Ils ne modifient PAS le score individuel, mais le clinicien doit en tenir compte : abaisser le seuil de discussion avec la surveillance, verifier les expositions, et envisager une reevaluation.
community.advisory_en: Recent community signals exist in the patient's area. They do NOT change the individual score, but the clinician should consider them: lower the threshold to discuss with surveillance, re-check exposures and consider reassessment.
community.advisory_sw: Kuna ishara za hivi karibuni za jamii katika eneo la mgonjwa. HAZIBADILISHI alama ya mgonjwa, lakini mhudumu anapaswa kuzizingatia: zungumza mapema na timu ya ufuatiliaji, hakikisha tena kuhusu kugusana, na fikiria tathmini upya.

early_warning.note: Statistical signal only: current week > mean + 2 SD of previous 4 weeks. Not an outbreak confirmation.
early_warning.note_fr: Signal statistique uniquement : semaine en cours > moyenne + 2 écarts-types des 4 semaines précédentes. Ce n'est pas la confirmation d'une épidémie.
early_warning.note_sw: Ishara ya kitakwimu tu: wiki hii > wastani + mikengeuko 2 ya kawaida ya wiki 4 zilizopita. Si uthibitisho wa mlipuko.

gi.rationale: Usually part of one gastro-intestinal syndrome; capped so four GI symptoms count 8 rather than 14.

pain.rationale: Non-specific and highly correlated (also typical of malaria); capped at 3.

neuro.rationale: Coma implies altered consciousness; counted once.

output_label_sw: Alama ya kushuku BDBV (0-100) - kipimo cha mpangilio, SI uwezekano wa maambukizi
